craft_notes: Sthāyin: Resting in dependence (nirvṛti). Kept (feigning stated, pronouncing sued). Rejected: 'crop' for 'yield' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Feat love, though feigned, has genuine fruit arising —
if this were straight, what yield? — pronounce it thou.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kṛtrimāpi bhavadbhaktir akṛtrimaphalodayā niśchadmā ced bhaved eṣā kiṃphaleti tvayocyatām

reads_against.argmap: Even artificial devotion to you has genuine fruit arising. → Artificial devotion fruits; guileless — what fruit? You say.
c1_essence: Feigned love true-fruited: guileless crop pronounced by you.
reads_against.l2: Feigned love of you still ripens true — were it straight, O what crop? Pronounce it, you.
l3: Feat love, though feigned, fruits unfeigned — were it straight,
reads_against.t1: Even artificial devotion to you has genuine fruit arising — if this were guileless, what-fruited — by you let it be said.
